scope: Local development comparisons against the original model, not ground-truth 3D reconstruction. The image-encoder layer allocation was selected using Chelsea and astronaut; coffee was not used for that selection. Denoiser calibration used armchair, avocado and Chelsea. The combined Idol model uses original image encoders; encoder and denoiser errors have not been jointly evaluated in these reports.

chelsea.attribution: CC0 photo by Stefan van der Walt, distributed with scikit-image

astronaut.attribution: NASA photograph of Eileen Collins, described as public domain by scikit-image

encoder_q8.scope: Two real photographs not used for DINO conversion or Gaussian calibration, original FLUX.2 autoencoder, runtime-half Idol denoiser; 50 steps seed42. DINO linear matrices packed on GPU and expanded per call; stage_encoders enabled. Compares latents to original DINO, not ground-truth 3D. Local xFormers disabled due incompatible environment.

encoder_q6.scope: Two real photographs not used for DINO conversion or Gaussian calibration, original FLUX.2 autoencoder, runtime-half Idol denoiser; 50 steps seed42. DINO linear matrices packed on GPU and expanded per call; stage_encoders enabled. Compares latents to original DINO, not ground-truth 3D. Local xFormers disabled due incompatible environment.

encoder_conditioning.scope: Same image, model, preprocessing, random seed and runtime; original encoder versus independently converted packed DINOv3 encoders. Original FLUX.2 autoencoder retained. Relative errors are against original outputs, not ground truth. Local incompatible xFormers disabled.

encoder_selection.scope: DINOv3 Q8_0 sensitivity experiment: restore each consecutive group of eight transformer layers to original runtime bfloat16 while all other eligible linear weights remain Q8_0. Same preprocessed image for each variant. Measures relative final image-feature difference against original DINOv3; both photos are development inputs, not held out. No reconstruction or latency claim. Local incompatible xFormers disabled.

encoder_selective.scope: Q8_0 DINOv3 with selected groups of original runtime-bfloat16 matrices; groups chosen using Chelsea and astronaut feature errors. Fifty denoising steps, seed 42; same original FLUX.2 autoencoder and Idol denoiser. Coffee was not used to select encoder groups. Latent differences are not ground-truth 3D. Weights are replaced in memory, not exported. Local incompatible xFormers disabled.

encoder_q8_coffee.scope: One coffee photograph; all eligible DINOv3 linear matrices Q8_0, original FLUX.2 autoencoder and Idol denoiser; 50 steps, seed42. Compared with original DINOv3; not a ground-truth 3D comparison. Local incompatible xFormers disabled.

encoder_mixed_bf16_tensors.scope: All encoder tensor values compared with either source at original runtime bfloat16 or all-Q8 baseline; this is not an end-to-end output test.

encoder_mixed_bf16_pipeline.scope: Actual mixed-precision DINOv3 file versus previously measured in-memory selective encoder, original FLUX.2 autoencoder and Idol denoiser. Fifty steps, seed42, same photos. One run per case; memory and elapsed time are process-local and not paired benchmarks. Local incompatible xFormers disabled.

q8_0.scope: Same calibrated Gaussian decoder and octree, seed and image; original DINOv3 conditioning versus quantized DINOv3 conditioning. Compares sampled Gaussian centers and attributes, not ground-truth surfaces or rendered quality.

q6_k.scope: Same calibrated Gaussian decoder and octree, seed and image; original DINOv3 conditioning versus quantized DINOv3 conditioning. Compares sampled Gaussian centers and attributes, not ground-truth surfaces or rendered quality.

selective8.scope: Same calibrated Gaussian decoder and octree, seed and image; original DINOv3 conditioning versus mixed original-precision and Q8_0 DINOv3 conditioning. Compares sampled Gaussian centers and attributes, not ground-truth surfaces or rendered quality.

q8_0.scope: Same calibrated Gaussian decoder and octree, seed and image; original DINOv3 conditioning versus quantized DINOv3 conditioning. Compares sampled Gaussian centers and attributes, not ground-truth surfaces or rendered quality.

q6_k.scope: Same calibrated Gaussian decoder and octree, seed and image; original DINOv3 conditioning versus quantized DINOv3 conditioning. Compares sampled Gaussian centers and attributes, not ground-truth surfaces or rendered quality.

selective8.scope: Same calibrated Gaussian decoder and octree, seed and image; original DINOv3 conditioning versus mixed original-precision and Q8_0 DINOv3 conditioning. Compares sampled Gaussian centers and attributes, not ground-truth surfaces or rendered quality.

denoiser_q8.scope: All 24 denoiser blocks; blockwise covariance compensation keeps standard Q8_0 tensor encoding. Covariance uses sampled layer inputs from armchair, avocado and Chelsea, 10 steps, seed42; all listed images are development checks following previous experiments. Encoded tensors are expanded to half precision for evaluation, not an implemented runtime/exporter. No ground-truth 3D comparison.

counts.source: see original Q4 covariance experiment report

denoiser_q6.scope: All 24 denoiser blocks; blockwise covariance compensation keeps standard Q6_K tensor encoding. Covariance uses sampled layer inputs from armchair, avocado and Chelsea, 10 steps, seed42; astronaut, coffee, castle and rocket are development checks; grandma and grapes are newly reserved held-out inputs. Encoded tensors are expanded to half precision for evaluation, not an implemented runtime/exporter. No ground-truth 3D comparison.

counts.source: see original Q4 covariance experiment report

denoiser_q4_q6.scope: Experimental mixed precision: covariance-compensated Q4_K matrices except the 8 or 16 blocks ranked most sensitive on two earlier 10-step training images, which use compensated Q6_K. Other weights retain original runtime precision. Lamp and lollipop are reserved 50-step gallery comparisons. Encoded matrices expanded to half; not a production exporter or ground-truth 3D comparison.

chelsea.scope: Actual complete Idol GGUF with covariance Q8_0 denoiser block matrices and covariance Q2_K Gaussian matrices; original image encoders; 50 steps, 262144 points. Local incompatible xFormers disabled. Compares to original runtime and original Gaussian output, not ground-truth geometry.

astronaut.scope: Actual complete Idol GGUF with covariance Q8_0 denoiser block matrices and covariance Q2_K Gaussian matrices; original image encoders; 50 steps, 262144 points. Local incompatible xFormers disabled. Compares to original runtime and original Gaussian output, not ground-truth geometry.
